hero.title: Technical Project Lead · Digital Products, E‑Commerce & AI
hero.claim: Clarity for digital projects. Alignment for strong teams.
hero.lead: More than ten years of frontend and e-commerce experience provide the technical foundation for structured project delivery. Requirements become understandable, dependencies visible and digital initiatives are supported reliably through to release.

evidence.label: Verified experience signals
evidence.years: years of digital development and delivery experience
evidence.brands: brands in the Unilever project environment

profile.title: Technical foundation. Clear focus on project leadership and delivery.
profile.intro: Years of hands-on development make technical opportunities, risks and dependencies easier to assess early.
profile.body: That experience underpins the focus on technical project leadership: translating requirements across business, design and engineering, documenting decisions clearly and protecting quality from briefing to release. The AI Project Manager programme completed in April 2026 adds AI business cases, MLOps, Responsible AI and data protection. The next stage of professional development is focused on a long-term technical project management role within an established team.
profile.principle: Work with structure, communicate clearly and keep commitments.

strengths.title: What keeps projects workable
strengths.intro: Three capability areas, each supported by a concrete experience signal rather than a list of buzzwords.

delivery.title: Project & Delivery
delivery.body: Turn complex initiatives into clear next steps, expose dependencies and protect quality through to release.
delivery.evidence: Supported by several years of enterprise e-commerce delivery in the ALDI Süd US & DE environment.

translation.title: Requirements & Interfaces
translation.body: Translate business goals, design requirements and technical reality into work that teams can understand and deliver.
translation.evidence: Supported by multi-brand and white-label work for more than ten Unilever brands.

commerce.title: E-Commerce & Technology
commerce.body: Assess platforms, storefronts and technical solution paths realistically from extensive delivery practice.
commerce.evidence: Supported by Shopify/Liquid, Shopware, Spryker, WordPress and the Shopify Liquid Storefronts certification.

cases.title: Case Studies
cases.intro: Selected work from long-term roles in established teams shows contribution, approach and supported experience without disclosing unapproved metrics or internal details.

aldi.summary: Enterprise e-commerce delivery in an international, cross-market environment for Germany and the United States.
aldi.focus: Technical requirements, frontend delivery and quality assurance
aldi.context: Digital e-commerce solutions for two markets required reliable implementation in a complex enterprise environment involving several disciplines.
aldi.contribution: During the role at Patrick & Friends: collaboration within the diva-e project context, focused on frontend delivery, technical requirements, cross-functional alignment and quality assurance.
aldi.approach: Assess requirements technically, expose open dependencies, keep delivery status understandable and support quality through reviews and releases.
aldi.evidence: Several years of enterprise e-commerce experience in the ALDI Süd project environment in Germany and the United States.
aldi.learning: In complex delivery environments, reliability comes primarily from clear requirements, visible dependencies and quality criteria understood by everyone involved.

unilever.summary: Modular white-label solutions, websites, relaunches and promotions for more than ten brands in the DACH region.
unilever.focus: White label, brand consistency, reviews and releases
unilever.context: Several brands needed distinct digital experiences built on a reusable technical foundation.
unilever.contribution: During the role at deepblue networks: hands-on delivery and maintenance of modular solutions, coordination of technical requirements with internal teams and external agencies, and support for reviews and releases.
unilever.approach: Build reusable structures, translate brand requirements accurately into delivery, and document decisions and progress for stakeholders.
unilever.evidence: Digital solutions for more than ten Unilever brands, including publicly named project environments such as Knorr, Dove, AXE and Magnum.
unilever.learning: A shared platform creates value only when reusability and brand-specific requirements receive equal attention.

koro.body: Shopify project during the role at Patrick & Friends in July and August 2023: storefront, Liquid implementation, design-to-code and technical quality assurance.
